entries.speaker: Return from Ruin, Part 1
entries.en: Accompanied by Akechi, the Phantom Thieves[n]infiltrate Sae Niijima's Palace—one inspired by[n]a casino...

entries.speaker: Return from Ruin, Part 1
entries.en: The Phantom Thieves find and defeat Shadow Sae.[n]However, [fName] is arrested in the[n]Palace by real-world police.

entries.speaker: Return from Ruin, Part 1
entries.en: As he's arrested, he learns of a [clr 2]traitor[clr 27] in their[n]midst. News of [fName]'s arrest circulates[n]throughout Tokyo...

entries.speaker: Return from Ruin, Part 1
entries.en: [fName] is taken to an underground [clr 2]interrogation[clr 27][n][clr 2]room[clr 27] and rigorously questioned by police, then by[n]Sae Niijima, bringing the story full circle.

entries.speaker: Return from Ruin, Part 1
entries.en: As [fName] fights the effects of the drugs and[n]remains silent about the Phantom Thieves, an [clr 2]assassin[clr 27][n]sent by the real culprit closes in...

entries.speaker: Return from Ruin, Part 1
entries.en: The assassin is none other than [clr 2]Goro Akechi[clr 27][n]himself, who pulls a gun on [fName] and kills[n]him. News reports of his death label it a suicide...
